thread:
michelle_sales: Hey team — ACME POC kickoff. Customer wants: SSO (SAML), SCIM auto-provisioning, group->RBAC mapping, domain allowlist (company-owned domains only), and clarity on Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Can we sync before Wed call?

devon_se: I can take SAML & SCIM details. Quick checklist: SAML attributes we expect: `email`, `name`, `groups` (optional). We require `NameID` email-format for user id.

claire_security: Also confirm session length & assertion signing algs. We require RSA-SHA256 signing (sha256) and want short assertion lifetime (<=5m). Need their IdP metadata XML.

michelle_sales: @claire_security good call. I'll ask them to drop metadata and their IdP contact. Pricing note: customer asked if Dedicated minimum can be monthly; they want numbers for 3-month POC.

jonathan_support: For SCIM: we support full user create/replace, group create, and delta sync using /Users and /Groups with `schemas` and `Operations`. We also support filtering on `/Groups?filter=displayName eq \"Eng\"`. Mapping-wise we do a `groupName -> role` mapping at tenant setup.

devon_se: Example mapping snippet I usually share:```json
{
  "scim_group": "acme-eng",
  "role": "developer"
}
```

michelle_sales: They'll want ability to map multiple groups to a single role and vice versa. Is that supported?

devon_se: Yes — many-to-many supported. We store role bindings per group. On provisioning we check group membership and apply the superset of role permissions. We also support a default role for users without groups.

claire_security: On domain controls: they want to constrain signups to corporate domains and require domain verification (DNS TXT). We use TXT with `redwood-verification=` token. Also provide option for org-admin enforced allowlist.

aisha_research: Quick question: do we do JIT provisioning on SAML assertions (just-in-time create on login) or require SCIM for POC?

devon_se: We support both. JIT on SAML is enabled by default for Hosted, but for Dedicated/Private we recommend SCIM for deterministic lifecycle (email changes, deprovisioning). For POC, SCIM + SAML JIT is a common combo.

michelle_sales: Customer also asked about SCIM delta frequency and performance for 50k users. Any limits?

jonathan_support: We handle bulk imports and delta syncs. For 50k users we'd recommend an initial bulk sync then delta (paged) every 5-15 minutes depending on plan. For Hosted the default rate limit is 10 reqs/min for SCIM endpoints; Dedicated can increase that with commit. We'll include recommended backoff headers in the doc.

claire_security: Security questionnaire items: SOC2 status (we're SOC2 Type II in prod), KMS for private keys (yes for Private deployments, hosted uses managed KMS), audit logs (per-user audit trail available), and VPC/PrivateLink options for Dedicated. I'll attach the canned answers in the drive.

michelle_sales: Action items before Wed: (1) Ask customer to send IdP metadata + sample assertion, (2) Request list of group names they want mapped, (3) Provide SCIM endpoints and limited example mapping + rate guidance, (4) Draft Dedicated POC pricing (3 months) and Hosted per-token estimate.

aisha_research: I'll draft the SAML/SCIM FAQ snippet and include the sample mapping & `NameID` note.

devon_se: I'll prepare a short playbook for the eng onboarding flow (SCIM token creation, required headers, example curl):```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/Groups' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"displayName":"acme-eng"}'
```

michelle_sales: @jonathan_support can you add the rate limit table and delta guidance to the shared thread?

jonathan_support: on it. Also noting a potential enterprise blocker: ACME's legal asked about cross-region data residency (EU only). We need to confirm Hosted region availability or propose Dedicated in eu-west-1.

claire_security: For EU-only, we can offer Dedicated in eu-west-1 with data residency and bring-your-own-key via KMS. I'll prepare the security note.

deploybot: deploy-bot: created doc `/docs/presales/acme-scim-saml-playbook.md` (draft) — please review. :robot_face: 

michelle_sales: Great — let's aim to circulate the doc + pricing by EOD Tuesday so the Wed call can be all demo and mapping decisions. Thanks team :pray:
